definitions.server_inference_s: reply.inference_seconds reported by the inference server
definitions.client_predict_minus_server_inference_s: client predict interval minus server inference; includes transport and other work
definitions.source_age: host monotonic event time minus request.source_time
definitions.submit_to_ack_s: logged acknowledgement minus logged submission; includes joint endpoint and any gripper completion
definitions.rpc_return_to_ack_s: logged acknowledgement minus MoveGripper RPC return; not the exact feedback duration
definitions.surrounding_servoj_gap_s: next ServoJ issue minus previous ServoJ return; an upper bound on the contained peripheral lock pause
definitions.completion_detection_bounds: controller completion detection is after RPC return and before both next ServoJ issue and target acknowledgement
definitions.prediction_observation: recorded valid gripper state at the observation source timestamp; not the controller completion-feedback timestamp
